tender_offers.terms: EUR500/share, 74% premium to 60-day VWAP, values company at EUR140.0M
tender_offers.note: Simplified tender offer for minority shares from the controlling family holding; stock now trades near the offer price awaiting resolution.

tender_offers.terms: Mandatory + voluntary public tender and exchange offer; consideration in Kruso Kapital (KK) shares, 23 KK shares per Banca Sistema share tendered
tender_offers.note: Banca CF+ launched a public tender and exchange offer for all Banca Sistema shares (offer documents approved by Consob 14 Jan and 30 Apr 2026); the offer succeeded, CEO Gianluca Garbi resigned 13 March 2026, and on 24 June 2026 the boards approved a merger plan to absorb Banca CF+ into Banca Sistema, completing the integration.

tender_offers.terms: EUR9.00/share simplified tender offer (OPAS) for the 16.5% of capital (843,402 shares) not already held
tender_offers.note: The Poulaillon family's holding company SAS Eugénie filed a simplified public tender offer (filed 23 April 2026, offer period 22 June-3 July 2026) at EUR9 per share to take full control of the bakery/pastry group, similar in structure to the Installux case.

tender_offers.counterparty: Epiris GP III (via Bradbury Bidco Ltd)
tender_offers.terms: GBP11.20/share cash, GBP1.02bn equity value / GBP1.08bn enterprise value, 53% premium to 7 Apr 2026 close
tender_offers.note: Gamma's board unanimously recommended a GBP1.02bn all-cash take-private offer from private equity firm Epiris via a scheme of arrangement; a rival, higher offer from Waterland Private Equity was reported to be forthcoming as of 7 September 2026, and closing is expected H1 2027.

tender_offers.counterparty: GLI Beteiligungsgesellschaft mbH / Grondbach GmbH (bidding consortium)
tender_offers.terms: Mandatory public offer at the statutory minimum price (weighted average 3-month domestic exchange price) under German WpÜG
tender_offers.note: A bidding consortium (GLI Beteiligungsgesellschaft and Grondbach GmbH, acting with further parties including Dr. Gerson Link and Reinhart Zech of Hymmen) acquired control of InnoTec TSS AG on 25 June 2026, triggering a mandatory takeover offer for all remaining shares.

mergers_acquisitions.note: adesso SE announced the acquisition of AI-powered insurance claims-processing specialist omni:us to strengthen its in|sure Ecosphere insurance platform.

mergers_acquisitions.terms: USD30m initial cash consideration, up to USD60m total (earnout-dependent)
mergers_acquisitions.note: dotdigital agreed to acquire Alia Software, an AI-powered Shopify pop-up/list-growth tool with ~USD8m forward ARR, funded from existing cash.

mergers_acquisitions.terms: 0.9725 Rejlers class B shares per Multiconsult share; 54% Multiconsult / 46% Rejlers ownership of combined company
mergers_acquisitions.note: Multiconsult and Rejlers announced a cross-border statutory merger to create a pan-Nordic multidisciplinary consultancy group, with boards adopting a joint merger plan on 7 September 2026.

mergers_acquisitions.terms: Cash plus non-cash share issue of SEK 24.3m (429,610 series B shares at SEK 56.63)
mergers_acquisitions.note: Dedicare completed the acquisition of two Danish social-sector staffing businesses, Hyldgaard & Larsen and Sustina, financed with cash and newly issued shares.

mergers_acquisitions.terms: Funded via EUR80m bridge-to-equity facility, later refinanced by a EUR80m rights offering
mergers_acquisitions.note: Revenio completed a transformative acquisition of Visionix, more than doubling pro forma net sales (to EUR252.8m) and expanding its addressable market ~2.5x in the eye-care sector.

mergers_acquisitions.counterparty: Clariane group (5 nursing homes) plus a separate operating-license acquisition
mergers_acquisitions.terms: 539 beds acquired; ~EUR25m annualized revenue add (~7-8% of French nursing-home revenue)
mergers_acquisitions.note: LNA Santé acquired five nursing homes (539 beds) from Clariane plus an operating license for a further 77-bed home, described by analysts as one of its largest deals since 2020.

Bogart's reference shareholder (the Konckier family) agreed to buy German perfumery chain Stadtparfümerie Pieper as a strategic partner for Bogart's fragrance business; separately, a July 2026 report references 'exclusive negotiations' between the Konckier family and the Marionnaud Group and an unspecified 'merger project' involving Bogart - details were not fully retrievable before the data source was exhausted, so treat this second item as preliminary/unconfirmed.

mergers_acquisitions.counterparty: Hampont (controlled by Maciej Dyjas and Nebil Senman)
mergers_acquisitions.terms: Hampont, an existing Murapol shareholder (16.9% at end of 2025, bought additional shares from exiting Ares fund), filed with Polish competition authority UOKiK on 26 March 2026 for approval to acquire exclusive control of Murapol. By early June 2026, the AEREF V PL Investments (Ares) fund sold its entire stake and Hampont solidified its position as the developer's largest/controlling shareholder. No mandatory tender offer was triggered as 'exclusive control' under concentration rules does not require majority ownership.
mergers_acquisitions.note: Change of controlling shareholder at a WSE-listed developer, with prior large institutional holder (Ares) fully exiting.

mergers_acquisitions.terms: CENIT increased its stake in subsidiary ISR from 74.9% to 100%, financing the buyout via a rights capital increase of approx. EUR 10.9 million (subscription period Aug 4-17, 2026); principal shareholder PRIMEPULSE SE took up unsubscribed shares.
mergers_acquisitions.note: ISR is CENIT's most profitable subsidiary (EUR 3.5m net profit 2025); increases CENIT's earnings concentration in ISR and changes share count via capital increase.

other.note: Bastide completed the sale of subsidiary New Medical Concept (holding company of the EXPERF home-infusion/clinical-nutrition group, EUR42m revenue) to Sapio Group as part of active portfolio management.

YouGov commenced a strategic review of its Shopper division (the former GfK Consumer Panel Services business), exploring options including a possible sale or combination of the unit's data assets; not yet a completed transaction.

Amid a capital shortfall, BFF Bank's board launched a process to find financial/strategic partners and received non-binding expressions of interest, including from BPER Banca for BFF's payment and custodian-banking businesses specifically; outcome still pending.

ProCredit Holding signed an agreement to sell its majority stake in ProCredit Bank Ecuador (South America segment), expected to close in 2026 subject to local regulatory approval; the business is now reported as discontinued operations.

SergeFerrari Group transferred its share listing from the regulated market of Euronext Paris to the lighter-touch Euronext Growth Paris multilateral trading facility, effectively delisting from the regulated market (shareholder approval 22 April 2026, effective 24 June 2026).

other.terms: Sold its gravity smoke-extraction and fire-ventilation business (transferred first into a subsidiary, then sold) to Kingspan Group for up to PLN 420M (PLN 90M of that deferred/contingent on trailing-12-month EBITDA through March 2026); transaction closed ~October 2025.
other.note: Company rebranded from Mercor S.A. to mcr Spolka Akcyjna following the sale, and paid an unusually large special dividend (PLN 1.78/share, well above the prior year) from the proceeds. This is a divestiture + cash-return event, not a classic spinoff (shareholders did not receive shares in a new listed entity) - explains both the name change and the ~53% drop in market cap picked up in this project's market-cap refresh, which is a mechanical consequence of the business/cash leaving the company, not organic deterioration.

other.terms: After a EUR 406m loss in 2025 and near-insolvency, Maisons du Monde completed a refinancing/restructuring validated by the Nantes commercial court: British funds Alteri Investors and Eicos Investment Group took over ~95% of the company's capital by converting EUR 218m of existing bank debt into equity via a massively dilutive capital increase, plus EUR 25m new financing. Conciliator separately mandated to prepare a 'prepack' disposal for Maisons du Monde France and Maisons du Monde SA.
other.note: Near-total change of control via distressed debt-to-equity swap; existing shareholders massively diluted. Any legacy valuation score is meaningless post-restructuring.

other.type: mandatory takeover offer + strategic divestiture review
other.terms: BANASINO INVESTMENTS S.a r.l. acquired control of Surteco (30% of voting rights) on Oct 4, 2024, triggering a mandatory offer at EUR 16.96/share; the Surteco Pool (56.87% of voting rights) did not accept and the management/supervisory board did not recommend acceptance. Separately, in January 2026 Surteco confirmed media reports of a strategic review to sell larger parts of the group, including the Profiles and Edgebands (baseboard/technical profiles) business units; in April 2026 the company secured refinancing to 2029 to support the ongoing restructuring.
other.note: Both a 2024 change-of-control event via mandatory tender and an active 2026 plan to divest major business divisions -- directly analogous to the Mercor/Kingspan divestiture pattern.

other.terms: Ailleron was in advanced, exclusive negotiations to sell its Software Mind subsidiary (a software house) to US private equity firm Tailwind Capital Partners IV. Poland's UOKiK antitrust approval was obtained Feb 26, 2026, and the exclusivity period was extended March 17, 2026, but Tailwind halted/withdrew from negotiations on April 8, 2026, citing unfavorable macro/market conditions (not diligence issues).
other.note: A material planned divestiture of Ailleron's core subsidiary that ultimately fell through in April 2026; strategic review of Software Mind may resume, and market may still be pricing in sale expectations.

other.type: failed takeover approaches + large self-tender buyback
other.terms: GlobalData received takeover approaches from private equity firms KKR (collapsed May 2026) and ICG (talks ended June 2026). Following the collapse, GlobalData launched a GBP 60m tender offer (initially reported as GBP 30m at 85p/share, 16% premium) to return capital to shareholders, on top of an existing GBP 5m buyback (total GBP 45-60m return for the year). Company also moved from AIM to the Main Market in March 2026.
other.note: Stock may still carry residual takeover-premium expectations from the failed PE approaches; large self-tender also changes share count materially.
